moments.title: Is the '10x engineer' claim even real?
moments.insight: Vadim argues that measuring engineers by speed or output is an unreliable illusion, much like counting lines of code.

moments.title: AI cuts client dev costs by 4x
moments.insight: Defco says AI-driven development has cut project costs for clients by at least four times in most cases.

moments.title: Skip the sexy startups—go where no one looks
moments.insight: His playbook: target the most compliance-heavy, 'unsexy' industries like banking and healthcare because competition is thin and automation opportunity is huge.

moments.title: Founders are lonely, and passion beats fear
moments.insight: He says great founders show a visible 'fire' in their eyes—either fear of losing or passion to win—and without it, it's a lost cause.

moments.title: "We don't need coders anymore"
moments.insight: Vadim claims his teams now build systems where AI writes 100% of the code, and touching the code yourself breaks the point of agentic development.
